facts.text: Dawn Spacecraft was deployed at Occator Crater (Cerealia Facula) during Dawn at Ceres in 2015.

Robotic explorer measuring 19.7 meters wing-to-wing. Carried three xenon ion thrusters, framing cameras, and a visible/infrared mapping spectrometer. Currently orbiting silently around Ceres in a perpetual graveyard orbit.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Proved that Ceres is an active, water-rich dwarf planet with an ancient global ocean, subsurface briny reservoirs, and organic molecules on its surface.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Occator Crater (Cerealia Facula).
A permanent human and robotic monument celebrating space exploration on the Moon.
